t: This is the Royal Air Force Club, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Adolphus Croft, who was the in-house architect for the furniture makers Gillow and Company, later known as Waring and Gillow. That's a nice detail to hold onto as you look at it: the design comes from an architect working for a firm famous for furniture and interiors, rather than from an independent practice. Croft lived from 1831 to 1893.
